backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining user profiles, access control checks, and full habit data structures with creation, completion tracking, and volume tracking logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing goal-removal UI changes and associated frontend file impacts for three features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend files describing components, utilities, and behavior across the habit‑tracking UI.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base and theme variable definitions for light and dark modes with OKLCH color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component setting up React Query, global layout, authentication controls, and the BecomingView.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthRequire: Alert component shown to unauthenticated users with an explanation and login button.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthStateIn: Badge showing authenticated or unauthenticated state based on Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login/logout with visual state changes.
frontend/src/features/becoming/api/queri: React Query hooks for loading, creating, updating, and toggling habit data with actor-based backend calls and optimistic updates.
frontend/src/features/becoming/component: Main view that handles auth, data loading, and displays habit manager, month tabs, and the habit grid.
Shows an error alert with the backend loading failure message.
Renders a skeleton UI placeholder for the habit grid while data is loading.
Modal for editing a habit’s name, unit, and volume with validation and update mutations.
Displays the habit grid with day columns and rows for each habit or an empty state when none exist.
Defines layout constants and helpers for consistent habit grid column sizing.
Handles creating new habits through an add‑habit input and mutation.
Represents a single habit row with completion checkboxes, info display, and edit actions.
Popover for habit‑row actions, currently providing an Edit option.
Renders month selection tabs for navigating between months.
frontend/src/features/becoming/constants: Provides month metadata for 2026 and helpers to get month info and day counts.
frontend/src/features/becoming/state/hab: Defines helpers to build and query habit completion maps and compute volume display strings and monthly totals.
frontend/src/features/becoming/utils/tim: Provides validation, parsing, formatting, and normalization utilities for time strings in minutes or M:SS formats.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook that loads, manages, and exposes authentication state using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers and a light cyber-themed design system with custom color variables and glass effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers and mounts the root component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, container settings, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Defines the project state focusing on removing all goal-related UI and retaining only monthly totals, with related feature entries and metadata.
